body: Replace the mailto-only CTA on /enterprise with an on-brand contact form (client component) that POSTs to /api/contact, shows success/error states, and KEEPS the mailto link as a visible fallback (AC10). Wire Vercel BotID: withBotId() in next.config.mjs and initBotId({protect:[{path:/api/contact,method:POST}]}) in instrumentation-client.ts. Ship /privacy (draft disclosing both processors Attio+Resend, purpose, retention, contact-to-delete; PM-F) linked from /enterprise and the home footer (AC9). Add .env.example documenting every var with no real values (AC11). Verification: cd apps/docs && npm run build && node --test test/enterprise-contact.test.mjs test/privacy-page.test.mjs test/env-example.test.mjs && npm run types:check. Satisfies AC9-AC12. allow-suppression: none

edges.contract: T-CC2 exposes POST /api/contact with the shared envelope; T-CC3 form consumes it.

title: Contact capture: /enterprise form + /privacy page + BotID wiring + .env.example
